name: Ore-tachi ga Shinda Natsu, Tenshi no Ita Mikkakan.
original_name: 俺たちが死んだ夏、天使のいた三日間。
source:
"If there were only three days left in the world, what would you do?"

Kousuke was on his loathing daily routine of nothingness when a weird girl that calls herself an Angel appears and tells him those words. Soon after that he decides to go to the sea with a charming girl wearing pajamas on a small trip to escape from reality.
translation:
“如果世界只剩下三天，你会做些什么？”

孝介日复一日地过着令自己厌恶、毫无意义的生活。这时，一个自称天使的奇怪女孩出现，对他说了这句话。没过多久，他便决定和一位穿着睡衣的迷人女孩去海边，来一场逃离现实的短途旅行。
